profile.summary: Rajnandini Metal Limited manufactures and trades copper continuous casting rods and wires in India. The company offers copper, brass, zinc, aluminium, and ferrous and nonferrous metals. It also provides copper rods, annealed bare copper wires, fine copper wires, bunched copper wires, and submersible wires and flat cables.
